preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the first part must be between 1 and 2000.
The number of vertices in the second part must be between 1 and 2000.
The number of edges must be between 0 and 2000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ui <= n1 and 1 <= vi <= n2 for ui, vi in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect valid vertices within the specified ranges.

postconditions.description: If the minimum degree is 0, the output must be 0.

postconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == cntk for cntk, edges in zip(output_counts, output_edges))
postconditions.description: The number of edges in each output line must match the specified count.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= edge_index <= m for edge_index in edges) for edges in output_edges)
postconditions.description: All edge indices in the output must be valid and within the range of the input edges.
